Global Art Collaboration

CREATING BEYOND BORDERS

At Art Dafen, we believe that great art is born from connection. By collaborating with artists from around the world, we bring together diverse ideas, cultures, and styles to create something truly meaningful. Whether you’re an emerging voice or an established name, partnering with us means joining a platform that values originality, supports creative growth, and helps your work reach a wider, global audience.

Benefits

PARTNERING WITH ART DAFEN

Global Reach

Showcase your work through exhibitions, digital platforms, and global partnerships.

Cultural Exchange

Collaborate with artists and designers from around the world to inspire fresh ideas.

Creative Support

Access resources and a dedicated team that values both creativity and quality.

Sustainable Growth

Transform your art into lifestyle products that expand your audience and income.

WHO WE’RE
LOOKING FOR

We welcome artists from all creative backgrounds — whether your practice is in painting, sculpture, illustration, or mixed techniques.

We're seeking creators who:

  • Have a clear artistic voice and produce original, authentic work
  • Uphold high standards of quality, creativity, and cultural relevance
  • Believe in bringing art into everyday life in meaningful ways
  • Are open to international collaboration and expanding their reach

Whether you're emerging or established, if your vision resonates with ours, we’d love to hear from you.

How to Apply

APPLICATION PROCESS

Prepare Your Portfolio

Select 5–10 recent works with titles, short descriptions, and any relevant links. Add a brief bio highlighting your artistic path.

Submit Your Application

Email your portfolio and bio to us at info@artdafen.com. Be sure to include your full name and contact details.

Review & Response

Our curatorial team will assess your submission. You’ll receive a response within 14 business days if selected.

Begin the Collaboration

Once approved, you’ll become part of our artist network and explore new opportunities with us.

Get In Touch

COLLABORATION INQUIRIES

Have questions about the collaboration or need help with your application? We’re here to support you.

Reach us at: info@artdafen.com
Or use the form to send us a message.

Let’s create something meaningful together.

Send a Message

We typically respond within 3–5 business days.

Business Hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM (Lunchtime: 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM)
